cases.scope: Source-shaped POSIX wait/notification characterization: one active producer/helper, one fully published coherent chunk, one optional spurious helper wake, one strong phase. Distinguishes final empty probe, mutex acquisition, count decrement, atomic waiter registration/unlock, unbuffered work notification, mutex reacquisition, producer local drain and protected termination signaling. Source negative control demonstrates a missed work-wake opportunity, not GC deadlock; single-sided proposed repairs also fail. Positive initializes source and all three proposal policies, proves finite count/closure/progress for each and notification reliability only for the combined under-mutex recheck plus protected-signal contract. Assumes producer can locally drain its own exported queue and remains counted through marking return. Folded producer count/wait step is valid here because it publishes no further work. Excludes arbitrary graphs/producers/cardinalities/phases, actual queue-lock nesting, unbounded spurious wakes, condition errors/destruction, C weak memory, native acceptance and measured speedup. No runtime repair is implemented.
